text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur gets injured during training,
so I take
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Might've been thinkin' too much
while I was
running. Such a dumb
mistake.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But whatever. I can overcome little
irregularities
like this, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm all patched up. Let's get
back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That supposed to be a joke? Injuries like
this are
a dime a dozen.
choice_data_list: ちゃんと休んだほうがいい
せめて軽めのトレーニングにしよう

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Spare me the stupid analogies, will
you?
choice_data_list: ケガはケガ、0か1で言えば1だよ

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's a waste of time talking to you. I'm
gonna head
back to my room and
compile data. I take it you
don't have a
problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur returns to her dorm looking

dissatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll be the one to decide whether to take
it easy or
not. Either way, efficiency is
gonna take a hit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we make our way to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get her to start with a light jog, but Air
Shakur's
face twists in pain.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... So this isn't gonna go my way
either, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Way to state the obvious. Geez...
choice_data_list: ここまでにしたほうがよさそうだな
ここまでにしたほうがよさそうだね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur returns to her dorm,
grumbling
unhappily.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It should be fine if I keep it light. That
way I won't
lose my edge.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, let's get some data on
my
performance while injured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur keeps her training light and
takes care
not to aggravate her injury.
